text: The column-state database catch logs an error and still returns before setCharProperty/commit. The related test changes add event-loop ticks after existing popup/frame or apply-notification waits. Those ticks are not a direct persistence-state condition, and the diagnostic does not repair a missing database. Keep the attempted intermittent mitigation separate from a demonstrated cause or fix.
title: Column-state diagnostics and extra test ticks do not establish persistence completion
